exhibits.title: The five questions on imported FMCG, answered
exhibits.subtitle: Answer, deciding evidence and how sure we are · desk research to early Oct 2026
rows: How big is it, and how has it grown?
Recorded consumer goods imports fell from US$4.7 bn (FY2022-23) to an estimated ~US$2.7 bn (FY2025-26); imported FMCG about US$1.5 bn in 2025
MoC tables to mid-2024; total imports US$12.5 bn in FY2024-25 [USDA FAS Aug 2025]
Thailand first by far; dairy, ingredients and bakery lead; Yangon modern trade carries premium lines, wet markets the rest
Thai food supply US$1.5 bn in 2025 [USDA FAS Jun 2026]; modern retail ~7% of sales [USDA FAS Aug 2024]
What drives and holds back demand to 2030?
Urban premium demand, hotels and food processors support it; licences, FX, tariffs and conflict cap it. Base case ~US$1.8 bn by 2030
One licence per HS code a month [Tilleke Jan 2026]; food duties raised May 2026 [USDA FAS May 2026]
A handful of national distributors and three grocers that hold under 2% of grocery sales; foreign brands sell via distributors or local plants
City Mart 1.1% share [USDA FAS Jun 2026]; Nestlé via MDG [FoodBev Mar 2023]
Goods are not embargoed; listed banks, military firms and the FATF blacklist shape payments and partners
exhibits.source: Source: [MoC 2024]; [USDA FAS Jun 2026]; [Tilleke Jan 2026]; [FATF Jun 2026]; [Kira estimates]

exhibits.title: Import rules an FMCG importer must clear in 2026
exhibits.subtitle: Myanmar · rules reported by legal advisers and the US agricultural attaché · Oct 2026
columns: What it means for an importer
rows: No goods enter without a TradeNet 2.0 licence; 1,460 items need manual approval
Since Jun 2023; list from Aug 2024 [JETRO Nov 2025]
One application per HS code a month
Each company files once a month per product code; one licence is approved
An application not approved in 180 days is cancelled by the system
Importers must show export earnings equal to the foreign currency they need
Unpublished caps of about US$50,000 a day by border and US$100,000 by sea per company
Telegraphic transfer of 100% only after arrival and customs clearance
No stickers; a Burma FDA Food Product Code on the label
exhibits.source: Source: [JETRO Nov 2025]; [Tilleke Jan 2026]; [A&G Jan 2026]; [USDA FAS Aug 2025]; [USDA FAS Jun 2026]

Ownership screening against US, EU and UK lists, repeated each year
